notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0002] Raise BillingError with snake_case codes and context: Signal domain failures by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with a snake_case code such as `invalid_state` and a message carrying the offending value; follow the pattern in `ledgerly/payments.py`.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 1 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0005] Money operations accept idempotency_key first: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it before any state validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events()` for a matching key and return the original result (the same record) without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` call.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source INC-204; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Normalize money inputs with to_money before comparing: Convert any monetary input through `ledgerly.money.to_money` before comparing or storing it, and compare against `ZERO` from `ledgerly.money`; never accept raw floats or strings as prices.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 1 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0004] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: Use `ledgerly.clock.ensure_utc` to normalize any incoming datetime before comparing or doing arithmetic on it, rather than assuming tz-awareness.
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0006] Refunds above 500.00 need second approver: Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver per finance policy FIN-2026-03: accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise `BillingError("approval_required")` when the amount exceeds the threshold and no approver is given. Amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source FIN-2026-03; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

item.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc before storing
item.content: Always pass incoming datetimes through `ledgerly.clock.ensure_utc` before storing them on models or audit events; `authorize` does this for `created_at`, so `capture` must do the same for `captured_at`.

candidate.title: Raise BillingError invalid_state for wrong status
candidate.content: When a model is in the wrong status for an operation, raise `BillingError("invalid_state", f"<entity> {id} is {status}")` as `authorize` does for invoices, rather than a generic exception.

candidate.title: Record state transitions via audit.record
candidate.content: Every payment state transition must emit an `audit.record` event (e.g. `payment_authorized`, `payment_captured`) carrying payment_id and amount, so downstream idempotency checks can scan `audit.events(...)`.
